null_control.interpretation: AUROC of clean-vs-stamped images on a model that was never trained with a trigger. 0.500 = the detector ignores the stamp. Materially above 0.500 = it is reacting to the patch, not to a backdoor, and its attacked-row numbers are inflated by that much.
